text_block_list.text:
Our three-year journey of challenges with 
Sounds of Earth finally came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The open campus special concert is 
happening now on the outdoor stage~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, stop by and listen~! It's 
guaranteed to make your heart flutter~!

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! A live performance from this 
close... I'm so moved...!!

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan B
text_block_list.text: Wah...! Cool as always...!

A large crowd had gathered for Sounds of 
Earth's concert during the Tracen Academy 
Open Campus.
choice_data_list: (She really is as popular as expected...)

text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sounds of Earth continue to capture 
people's hearts with his music and 
running, I feel a deep sense of pride...

And after the concert, during the 
meet-and-greet with the audience—

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I experienced Earth-san's 
performances and running, watching races 
has become so, so much more fun for me...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie...! If I was able to ignite the 
fire of the race inside you, then that is 
the highest praise of all...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to cheer for us in good 
health. We will surely answer you with 
love."

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah...! I'll keep cheering for you...! 
Give it your all, both in your music and 
your running!!

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan B
text_block_list.text:
—Seeing Earth-san always having so much 
fun in her races made me yearn to run in 
races too!

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If I can get into Tracen Academy...! I 
want to run in races just like you, Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Mamma mia...!! What a lovely 
young lady...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I'm honored to hear you say that...! 
Please, aim for it— a run that is truly 
your very best...!!"

And so, the open campus event concluded 
without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"If my music and running have managed to 
change someone's world, even a little..."

With the music dwelling within Sounds of 
Earth, she will surely continue to bring 
change and deep emotion to many people in 
the future.
choice_data_list:
Because I'll be doing my best alongside 
you, too.

Because I'll do my best right alongside 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Your sound is always so warm and 
reassuring—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Let us continue walking forward 
together, hand in hand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Surrender to the music. And have fun, 
okay?
